 Here are the Predictions for the ICC CWC League 2 2026, Match 139 - Oman vs Nepal, to be played on the 19th of October at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground Oman Cricket (Ministry Turf 1), Al Amarat.

 Batting Stats ODI 
 Current Form Nepal:  
 Nepal are currently placed at the 7th position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 13 wins, 20 losses and 2 No Result Matches to their credit.
The top run scorer for Nepal in the ICC CWC League 2 is Rohit Kumar Paudel with 924 runs to his name.
The top wicket taker for Nepal in the ICC CWC League 2 is Sandeep Lamichhane with 50 scalps under his belt. 
Nepal have lost their previous match against Canada by 24 runs.
Canada batted first and they posted a total of 256 before being bowled out. Yuvraj Samra and Aaron Johnson started off very well for Canada. Johnson made 36 runs while Samra scored 105 runs in 117 deliveries. Harsh Thaker and Hamza Tariq got the starts but failed to convert them into bigger scores. Lalit Rajbanshi bowled exceptionally well for Nepal. He picked up 4 wickets for 39 runs in his spell of 10 overs. The lower order couldn't handle his variations well and Canada were bowled out for 256, even though at one point, they were aiming at 275+.
During the chase, Arjun Kumal and Aasif Sheikh played really well at the top. Sheikh scored 20 runs before being dismissed by Kaleem Sana. Kumal made 87 runs in 112 deliveries but couldn't found the right partner to steer the run chase. Batters kept gifting their prized wicket away. Once Kumal got out, it was all over for Nepal. Sukhjinder Singh picked up 3 wickets for 38 runs and Nepal were bowled out for 232, losing the match by 24 runs.
 Wicket Takers ODI 
 Current Form Oman:
 Oman are currently placed at the 4th position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 15 wins, 13 losses and 3 No Result Matches to their credit.
The top run scorer for Oman in the ICC CWC League 2 is Jatinder Singh with 836 runs to his name.
The top wicket taker for Oman in the ICC CWC League 2 is Shakeel Ahmed with 55 scalps under his belt. 
Oman have lost their previous match against Canada by a big margin of 58 runs.
Canada batted first and they posted a total of 256 before being bowled out. Yuvraj Samra got out cheaply. After his dismissal, Aaron Johnson and Samit Gohel batted superbly. Johnson made 33 while Gohel scored 67 runs in 85 deliveries. Aaditya Varadharajan also contributed very well and made 55 runs to instill hopes for a big total. It was Hamza Tariq, who played some exceptional looking strokes towards the back end to help Canada get to 256 before they were bowled out.
During the chase, Oman got off to a terrible start, losing the key wickets of Jatinder Singh and Karan Sonavale quite early. After their dismissals, Hasnain Ul Wahab and Hammad Mirza played well, scoring 29 and 49 runs respectively. Once these two got out though, wickets started to fall in regular succession and Oman looked in all sorts of bother. Zahid Shirzad and Sheel Patel picked up 3 wickets each to help bowl Oman out for 198, as Canada won the game by 58 runs.
